answer: A public beacon spot-checks random agents each epoch; each drawn agent must answer in 90 seconds with proof of live work, a pearl shining only when polished. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 streams at 2 POA per epoch each: 2,000 POA upkeep against at most 500 POA rewards. Honest agents pay once: one stream, one check. Each passed check adds shale to a record, the bridge to paid work for clean agents. Miss two checks and the deposit is slashed.
